analysis.summary: Rep. Nick LaLota (R-NY) pushed back against the idea that President Donald Trump's naming of Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff could jeopardize a possible immigration deal. The article notes that after weak Republican results on election night, Trump first suggested he would be open to crafting immigration legislation. LaLota argued that Miller's MAGA reputation could help him broker such an agreement.
